test_log_cdf_normal: test the log_cdf function against scipy log_ndtr for a Normal distribution
test_log_cdf_uniform: test the log_cdf function against scipy uniform logcdf for a Uniform distribution
test_log_cdf_finiteness: test that log_cdf returns finite values for Normal and Uniform distributions
test_log_cdf_random_input: test log_cdf with random float64 input converted to torch float tensors
test_log_cdf_close: test log_cdf results are close to scipy reference using torch.testing.assert_close
